tools.deck.name: Question cards
tools.deck.hint: Your one shared deck of question and answer cards.
tools.quiz.name: Recall quiz
tools.quiz.hint: Close the book, answer from memory, then check.
tools.leitner.name: Review boxes
tools.leitner.hint: Each card comes back just as it starts to fade.
tools.mix.name: Mixed set
tools.mix.hint: Mix related topics and name each one before answering.
tools.guess.name: Guess first
tools.guess.hint: Guess before you study, then see what surprised you.
tools.relearn.name: Relearning rounds
tools.relearn.hint: Recall each card until it is right, then again on later days.
tools.blank.name: Blank page
tools.blank.hint: Write all you remember on a clean page, then find the gaps.
tools.feynman.name: Explain it simply
tools.feynman.hint: Explain it to a 12-year-old and see where you get stuck.
tools.lesson.name: Tiny lesson
tools.lesson.hint: Plan a tiny lesson, teach it card by card, then reflect.
tools.steps.name: Explain each step
tools.steps.hint: Go step by step and write why each one follows.
tools.sketch.name: Sketch and redraw
tools.sketch.hint: Sketch it next to a few words, then redraw it from memory.
tools.sets.name: Question sets
tools.sets.hint: Log your practice sets and see weak topics first.
tools.errors.name: Error log
tools.errors.hint: Write down each mistake, its cause and the lesson.
tools.whychain.name: Why chain
tools.whychain.hint: Ask “why?” about a fact, again and again, until you hit bedrock.
tools.examples.name: Examples
tools.examples.hint: Pin an abstract idea to varied, concrete examples.
tools.cornell.name: Cornell notes
tools.cornell.hint: Notes on the right, cue questions on the left, a summary below.
tools.questions.name: Question notes
tools.questions.hint: Turn each chunk of material into a question and its answer.
tools.map.name: Concept map
tools.map.hint: Ideas as boxes, joined by labelled links.
tools.table.name: Comparison table
tools.table.hint: Put look-alike things side by side, feature by feature.
tools.summary.name: One-page summary
tools.summary.hint: Sum a topic up from memory on one page, then fill what you missed.
tools.objectives.name: Objectives checklist
tools.objectives.hint: Paste the learning objectives and tick them off as you master them.
tools.acronym.name: Acronyms
tools.acronym.hint: Turn a list into first letters and a silly sentence.
tools.palace.name: Memory palace
tools.palace.hint: Place what you must remember along a walk you know well.
tools.chunk.name: Chunker
tools.chunk.hint: Split a long list or number into small groups.
tools.focus.name: Focus timer
tools.focus.hint: A calm Pomodoro: work, short break, repeat.
tools.parking.name: Thought parking
tools.parking.hint: Jot down a stray thought and get back to work.
tools.plan.name: Plan
tools.plan.hint: Your weekly rhythm of study blocks and a map of the term.
tools.reviews.name: Today’s reviews
tools.reviews.hint: The topics due for a review today.
tools.courses.name: Courses and topics
tools.courses.hint: Your courses, their topics and exam dates.
tools.top3.name: Today’s top 3
tools.top3.hint: The three things that would make today a good day.
tools.lab.name: Method experiment
tools.lab.hint: Try one method for a week or two and keep what works.
tools.wins.name: Wins
tools.wins.hint: Write down what you did, not only what is left.
tools.reflect.name: Weekly reflection
tools.reflect.hint: Three short questions to look back on your week.
tools.worry.name: Worry dump
tools.worry.hint: Empty your worries onto the page before you start.
tools.breathe.name: Breathing
tools.breathe.hint: A few slow breaths, guided, to calm down.
tools.mywhy.name: My why
tools.mywhy.hint: A short note on why you study, for the hard weeks.
tools.buddies.name: Buddies
tools.buddies.hint: Study rooms, shared goals and friendly challenges.
